Midde Rajivulla vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 January,
2020
Author: C.Praveen Kumar

entities.text: Midde Rajivulla vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: C.Praveen Kumar
 Honourable Sri Justice C.Praveen Kumar
 Criminal Petition No.6727 of 2019
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner / Accused under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in C.C.No.72 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the learned Judicial First Class Magistrate, Atmakur.

The alleged offences against the petitioner are under sections 188, 272 of IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
2. Heard Sri P.Nagendra Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent / State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner so also the learned Public Prosecutor submits that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 18.12.2019, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch.

4. Since, the issue involved in the present case is identical to the common order passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/Accused in C.C.No.72 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the learned Judicial First Class Magistrate, Atmakur, for the offences under sections 188, 272 of IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are hereby quashed.
5. Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 18.12.2019 passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch to this order.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal petition shall stand closed.

_______________________________ JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR Date : 02.01.2020 rpd THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR CRIMINAL PETITION No.6727 of 2019 Date : 02.01.2020 rpd Midde Rajivulla vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168965497/
